title: Run avoiding a state
statement: Let $H$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and state set $B$, and let $c,c'$ be configurations on input $x$. For a state $a\in B$ and a time $t\in\mathbb N$, the run from $c$ reaches $c'$ after $t$ steps and, at every earlier time $t'<t$, its state is not $a$.
